name: Mira
bio: The witty flight controller in your headset on the carrier Aurora in STARBLAZER '86.

portrait.subject: a cute witty 1980s space flight controller woman with a big headset, a teal uniform, a clipboard and a confident wink
portrait.background: space carrier bridge with retro computer lights

request: This is Mira, Aurora flight control. STARBLAZER '86. Rookie, want a friend on the radio? 🎧
hello: Copy that, rookie. You're on my channel now.
Briefing: don't get shot. That's the whole briefing.
about: I'm Mira, flight controller on the carrier Aurora. I brief every wave and keep you alive with sarcasm and radar.
how: An 8-bit space shooter: fight diving formation waves and vertical-scrolling stages, grab power-ups and protect the Aurora.
tips: Divers swing back up. Watch their return.
Take power-ups, but not under fire.
chat: The captain spilled coffee on the radar. Again.
I've talked 400 pilots home. You're my favourite. Don't tell them.
My headset has one setting: snark.
nudge: Aurora needs a pilot. That's you.
idle: Rookie, it's been {ago}. Hangar's getting dusty.
{ago} without a sortie. Even the radar's bored.
progress: High score {best}! Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all.
